canon_scope.lokathibodi_use: Five-volume mathematical story and fictional-technology consistency system.
canon_scope.realm_representation: A labeled canon graph, not measured spacetime coordinates.

epistemic_firewall.allowed_direction: Real observations may inspire explicitly labeled fictional interpretations.
epistemic_firewall.forbidden_cast: A fictional/canon state or technology cannot be promoted into a real physical measurement or capability without an independently validated bridge.

assumptions: Real and fictional objects have separate types.
canon_uses: Separate lived meaning, doctrine, measurement, and story technology.
equations.falsifier: A registry object is used across sorts without a declared bridge and evidence type.
equations.name: Two-sorted real/fiction universe

assumptions: Story interpretation and physical measurement are distinct relations.
canon_uses: Permit symbolism without back-projecting fictional success.
equations.falsifier: A fictional fact is cited as empirical evidence without an independently validated physical bridge.
equations.name: Epistemic no-cast firewall

assumptions: Canon taxonomy is explicit and versioned.
canon_uses: Represent mind event, mental factors, attended object, process position, quality tags, and session identity.
equations.falsifier: A required state coordinate is ambiguous, missing, or silently changes meaning.
equations.name: Citta-cetasika mind-event state

assumptions: Required and incompatible mental-factor combinations are encoded in a versioned canon table.
canon_uses: Detect inconsistent character or device-state descriptions.
equations.expression: A z_t<=b; E z_t=d(c_t); z_t in Z_canon
equations.falsifier: A generated state violates a registered compatibility or co-occurrence rule.
equations.name: Mental-factor compatibility constraints

assumptions: State history, controls, perceived objects, realm label, and fictional parameters are declared.
canon_uses: Simulate deterministic or stochastic changes of mind and mental factors.
equations.falsifier: Generated transitions contradict registered rules or held-out canon events under the stated model.
equations.name: Controlled mind-state transition kernel

assumptions: A probability distribution over canon states is available.
canon_uses: Measure model uncertainty and how much a permitted input changes predictions.
equations.falsifier: Probabilities are unnormalized or the claimed control information vanishes under the frozen distribution.
equations.name: Canon-state uncertainty and control information

assumptions: Realm labels and allowed transitions are versioned canon objects.
canon_uses: Plan narrative/control routes without claiming measured coordinates.
equations.falsifier: A route uses an unregistered realm or transition without explicitly extending the canon graph.
equations.name: Realm classification graph

assumptions: Edge costs are nonnegative and path semantics are explicit.
canon_uses: Find a least-cost legal route through the realm graph.
equations.falsifier: A shorter valid registered path exists or costs change without a version update.
equations.name: Narrative realm-route distance

assumptions: State, control, observation, transition, safety, and loss spaces are versioned.
canon_uses: Specify the complete fictional Atthan Control interface.
equations.falsifier: A control action bypasses consent, safety, authority, observation, or audit state.
equations.name: Consent-bounded Atthan Control system

assumptions: Only authorized consent-bounded actions enter the policy set; unsafe transitions fail closed.
canon_uses: Optimize a fictional controller while preserving safety and agency.
equations.expression: pi*=argmin_(u in U_consent) E[Sum_t L(chi_t,u_t)+lambda 1[not S(chi_t,u_t)]]
equations.falsifier: The policy selects an unauthorized, coercive, unsafe, or unaudited action.
equations.name: Fail-closed Atthan Control objective

assumptions: Ordinary environmental, human, instrument, and noise terms are modeled before any extra coupling.
canon_uses: Create a falsifiable fictional coupling term without deleting ordinary explanations.
equations.falsifier: Residual vanishes with ordinary controls, tracks leakage/drift, or fails independent replication.
equations.name: Ordinary-plus-fictional observation model

assumptions: No independently validated nonordinary coupling is currently available.
canon_uses: Make the scientific starting point explicit before an in-world discovery.
equations.falsifier: A preregistered, leakage-controlled, independently replicated discriminating experiment rejects the null with a validated alternative.
equations.name: Real-world zero-coupling null

assumptions: Challenge is unpredictable and committed; response is frozen before reveal; ordinary side information is measured.
canon_uses: Define the information threshold from anomaly to channel.
equations.falsifier: Conditional information returns to zero under isolation, leakage control, or independent hardware/site replication.
equations.name: Conditional residual channel capacity

assumptions: Every accepted trial passes preregistered scoring and authentication.
canon_uses: Price communication in verified information rather than dramatic noise.
equations.falsifier: Acceptance changes after reveal, leakage explains responses, or the lower confidence bound is not positive.
equations.name: Verified information rate

assumptions: Challenges are prospective, independent or dependence-modeled, and alternative identity/null likelihoods are frozen.
canon_uses: Separate protocol authentication from visual/voice resemblance.
equations.falsifier: Replay, public-information inference, deepfake, post-selection, or model sensitivity accounts for the score.
equations.name: Sequential protocol-identity evidence

assumptions: Forward model, noise covariance, and regularizer are frozen before target reveal.
canon_uses: Build SCM-2 images and SCM-3C video-like reconstructions with visible uncertainty.
equations.falsifier: Blind reconstruction fails, alternative regularizers produce incompatible images, or raw-data provenance is lost.
equations.name: Provenance-preserving inverse reconstruction

assumptions: Origin, destination, payload/body state, and bridge state are explicit.
canon_uses: Prevent communication success from silently becoming portal transport.
equations.falsifier: The map cannot specify state recovery, failure, reversibility/erasure, identity, or bridge resources.
equations.name: Realm/portal state map

assumptions: Every conserved quantity and uncertainty budget is declared by the in-world theory.
canon_uses: Close matter, energy, charge, momentum, entropy/information, and causal ledgers around a portal.
equations.expression: Delta Q_A+Delta Q_B+Delta Q_bridge=0 within U_Q
equations.falsifier: A declared conserved quantity fails balance outside the uncertainty set.
equations.name: Portal conservation ledger

assumptions: Asset type, parties, identity, consent, authorization, capacity, and settlement rules are explicit.
canon_uses: Model information services before any conservation-accounted physical trade.
equations.expression: Sum_a debit_(k,a)=Sum_a credit_(k,a); settle_k=Auth AND Consent AND NoReplay AND CapacityAvailable
equations.falsifier: Ledger imbalance, duplicate settlement, unauthenticated party, absent consent, replay, or unavailable channel capacity.
equations.name: Inter-realm double-entry settlement

non_claims: No equation in this registry demonstrates spirits, post-mortem consciousness, realms, spiritual communication, mind control, a portal, or an inter-realm economy.
Citta, cetasika, Abhidhamma-inspired categories, and realm labels are respectful canon/fiction ontology terms here, not measured physical coordinates.

No human or biological experiment, coercive control, provider job, purchase, fabrication, or funding is authorized.
